lines.text: BEEP BEEP! Seven o'clock alarm, and Leo was rushing around like a whirlwind!
Where is my left blue sneaker? Did anyone pack my homework notebook?
Spilling cereal, untied shoelaces, and running frantically as the yellow bus honked!
That night, Rhymo said, Let's win tomorrow before we even close our eyes!
Step one: Backpack packed and zipped right by the front door!
Step two: Blue sneakers placed side-by-side with socks inside!
Next morning, Leo woke up, got dressed in three minutes, and ate pancakes calmly!
He strolled to the bus stop five minutes early, smiling like a champion!
Win your mornings and win your days—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
